title: Cambridge-sourced, relation-context-aligned enrichment of eleven existing high-priority glossary targets
editorialStatus: Cambridge Dictionary entries checked 2026-11-24; definitions paraphrased and aligned against existing relation anchors; independent editorial review remains pending.
sourcePolicy: Only existing relation-target rows are updated. Meaning_vi and term identity are preserved. Every update is guarded by exact old values and the source file SHA-256. No canonical headwords or relation edges are created.

records.meaning_vi_preserved: trình bày; hiện tại; có mặt
records.definition_en: to be in a particular place or to exist at the current time; or to give, show or introduce information or someone to an audience
records.senseAlignment: The adjective senses (being in a place/current) and verb senses (showing or introducing) are selected for the existing current, introduce and submit relation anchors; the noun “gift” sense is excluded.
